title: fix(plugin-auth,plugin-email)!: the invitation mail warns once on an untranslated role label and states when it expires
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGEtunNCqKwXhkVr8xm2ygt)_

Part of #25802 (the in-repo half; the card stays open for the cloud control plane's i18n composition, routed to that lane)

Clause-②: no (narrowing: the built-in `auth.invitation` rows declare a new required variable, `expiresAt`, so a `sendTemplate` of `auth.invitation` that names no `expiresAt` is now refused with `MISSING_VARIABLES` where it used to be sent)

Metadata-protocol: none (a built-in template row's declared variables, read by the email service at send time; no spec key, authorable spelling or stored shape moves)

## What changes

Two fixes to the `auth.invitation` mail. Both are named on the card (the second is from its follow-up comment 6398750019).

1. **The role label: a warn when it stays untranslated.** `invitationRoleLabel` (`plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-label.ts`) now logs one `warn` per send when the mail's locale is not English and a role token's label is still its authored (English) text. The warn names the locale, the tokens and what to check: `[AuthManager] invitation mail: no 'zh-CN' label was found for the membership role(s) 'member'; the mail names the authored (English) label instead. …`. Before this, only a read that threw was reported. The read that answers but holds no zh-CN entry, which is the reported shape (`以 Member 的身份`, no log line), was silent. Each degradation gets one warn: a thrown read keeps its own warn and gets no second one, and a token outside the option list keeps its existing warn and is not counted again. An en-US or en-GB mail reads the authored label as its own text and logs nothing. The mail is always sent.
2. **The expiry.** The sender (`auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts`) passes `invitation.expiresAt` as a new **required** template variable, `expiresAt`, as an ISO-8601 instant. The engine has no conditionals, so every body states the expiry, and a send without it is refused (`MISSING_VARIABLES: expiresAt`) instead of being sent with a dangling "expires on ." sentence. If the value does not read as a date, the sender leaves it out and logs one `warn` that names the invitation id and says the mail will be refused, so the invitation can be resent. Each of the four built-in rows (en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES), in both the HTML and the text body, ends with one sentence that renders it as `{{ expiresAt | datetime:long }}`. This uses the date formatter the template layer already has (ADR-0053 Phase 2). The date reads in the row's locale and in the reference timezone the send names. The `long` style prints the zone name, so a reader never has to guess the zone. With UTC the sentences render as 「此邀请将于 2031年3月4日 UTC 05:06:07 过期。」, "This invitation expires on March 4, 2031 at 5:06:07 AM UTC.", 「この招待の有効期限は 2031年3月4日 5:06:07 UTC です。」 and "Esta invitación caduca el 4 de marzo de 2031, 5:06:07 UTC.".

## BREAKING

This is for code that sends `auth.invitation` itself. The built-in organization-invitation sender already passes the value, and it is the only sender in this repository (`git grep` at `origin/main`).

- **Before.** A send naming `inviter`, `organization`, `role`, `acceptUrl` and `appName` was delivered.
- **Now.** The same send is refused with `MISSING_VARIABLES: expiresAt`.
- **Fix (one line).** Add the invitation's expiry instant to the send's `data` as `expiresAt`.

The changeset carries `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, and `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts it.

## Measurement (the order's first step, at `origin/main` bbf70614)

- **objectstack ships the zh-CN labels:** `platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` has `sys_member.fields.role.options` = 所有者 / 管理员 / 受托管理员 / 成员 / 外部成员.
- **objectstack reads them through the file-based adapter.** A throwaway probe (not committed) booted a `LiteKernel` with the real `I18nServicePlugin` (the `registered file-based i18n adapter` the cloud log names) and the real `PlatformObjectsPlugin`, then called `invitationRoleLabel('member', 'zh-CN', { getI18n })`:

| i18n service configuration | `getLocales()` | label | warns on main |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| default | en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES | 成员 | 0 |
| `defaultLocale: 'en', fallbackLocale: 'en'` | en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES | 成员 | 0 |
| same + `supportedLocales: ['en']` | en | **Member** | **0** |
| same + `supportedLocales: ['en', 'zh']` | en, zh | **Member** | **0** |
| same + `supportedLocales: ['en', 'zh-CN']` | en, zh-CN | 成员 | 0 |
| `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN', fallbackLocale: 'en'` | en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES | 成员 | 0 |

The card's symptom (`Member` and no log line) reproduces only when the service's reported locales do not name `zh-CN`. `translateMetaList` builds its bundle from `getLocales()`. So the label read here is correct. The cloud control plane's i18n composition is the likely cause: a declared `supportedLocales`, or bundle registration. I could not read that half from this repository, and I have reported it to the seat. This PR adds the warn, which names exactly that check.

## Tests

Red first. The new and updated pins, run against the BASE implementation (the three source files restored from bbf70614, the tests kept): plugin-auth `invitation-role-label.test.ts` had **5 failed / 19 passed**, and plugin-email (`auth-templates-locales`, `builtin-auth-render-identity`, `plain-text-faces`) had **11 failed / 90 passed**. The source was then restored from HEAD and proven by `git diff HEAD` empty plus a blob-hash match on all three files.

Green, at head ee295b9b (after merging `origin/main`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth --filter @objectstack/plugin-email run test`: plugin-auth **197/197 files, 3753 passed, 10 skipped**; plugin-email **38/38 files, 699 passed**. The lock VERDICT was command-exit 0.
- `run typecheck` on both packages (tsc, examples config, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over every `.ts` file this PR touches: exit 0.
- **Dogfood battery** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` at ee295b9b, after its `^...` closure build. The lock VERDICT was command-exit 0. **Test Files 296 passed, 3 skipped (299); Tests 2523 passed, 18 skipped (2541)**. 0 failures.

What the pins hold:
- **The role label.** zh-CN with the platform bundles gives 成员 and no warn. A service whose locales omit zh-CN gives `Member` and one warn, whose meta names the role, the locale and that a service was present. No service at all on a zh-CN mail gives one warn: the existing pin asserted silence, and it now asserts the one warn. A list warns once, naming every English token. An out-of-list token is not double-counted. A thrown read produces exactly one invitation warn in total. en-US and en-GB mails produce no warn.
- **The expiry.** A `Date` and a string both reach the template as the ISO instant. A missing or unreadable expiry is left out of the data, with one warn naming `inv1` and the refusal. A readable expiry logs no expiry warn. In every locale, a send without `expiresAt` is refused with `MISSING_VARIABLES: expiresAt` and nothing reaches the transport. Per locale, both faces carry the expiry sentence for a UTC send. A send naming `Asia/Shanghai` moves the wall-clock and names `GMT+8`. A zh-CN mail carries no English expiry text. The existing every-fact-in-both-faces pin now covers `expiresAt`.
- **The byte-identity pin** (`builtin-auth-render-identity.test.ts`) now renders with `timezone: 'UTC'`, so its bytes never follow the machine's zone. Only the four `auth.invitation` rows' html/text digests moved. Every other template's 28 rows kept their digests under the UTC render.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 69 families at ee295b9b (the same set as the first round). All were run there, with exit codes captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciles: **69 derived, 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a full-repo build). CI runs it.
- The changeset gates, read on the committed narrowing changeset: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0 (it accepts the `no-migration-prescription` exemption), `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 and `check-empty-changeset` exit 0.
- CI families: see this PR's check-runs. Check Changeset reads this body's `Clause-②` line.

## Acceptance notes

- **The same dangle in the TTL templates (follow-up observation, not this PR).** `auth.password_reset`, `auth.magic_link` and `auth.two_factor_otp` declare `expiresInMinutes` `required: false` and print "expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes" unconditionally. A send without the value renders a dangling sentence. `auth.account_invitation` already declares its own `required: true`.
- **No timezone is passed.** The invitation send passes no reference timezone, like every other auth send today. So the wall-clock is the server's zone, named in the sentence by the `long` style. Passing the invitee's or the organization's timezone would be a separate change to the locale ladder, which this card does not ask for.
- **The two i18n providers handle a base-language locale differently.** This was observed while measuring and is not filed. With `supportedLocales: ['en', 'zh']`, `FileI18nAdapter.getTranslations('zh')` answers `{}`: it matches exactly, and the bundles are keyed `zh-CN`. The kernel's in-memory provider resolves `zh` to the zh-CN bundle. So the same declaration translates on one provider and not on the other. The measurement is a composed-kernel probe only, with no public-door reading, so per the report contract it is a note here and not a card. Owner: none.
- `#24154` stays closed. Its ruling (the role in a Chinese invitation reads 「成员」) is what the label read already delivers, and this PR makes the residual miss loud.
